title: review-jev-rules: an additional orchestrator reviewer that checks every changed hunk against every applicable project rule with Jev

AC1.note: src/commands/review-jev-rules.ts implements CLI 'keryx review jev-rules (--diff|--pr|--scope) [--rules][--max-calls][--json]'; src/review/jev-rules.ts synthesizeFindingsFromViolations emits findings with reviewer 'review-jev-rules' validated against reviewer-finding.schema.json (src/gdskills/bundled/skills/review/review-orchestrator via runJevRulesForShell/CLI path); bundled skill at src/gdskills/bundled/skills/review/review-jev-rules and installed copy at .metaproject/skills/gdskills/review/review-jev-rules. PR #722 (merged b73ef7fd16e4f0a9740972df9040f94c0f0de8fb, head 8f60bf30219a0e9de68bafa597d581fc10ef657c).

AC2.note: src/review/jev-rules.ts discovers rule sources from .metaproject/rules/**, rules/**, project/installed skills and --rules paths (round-2 fix commit 7ca33bb4730beed60ccb91dacbf43c4c22eeb617 added a directory-name filter matching auto-discovery for a --rules directory); classifyRuleSourceCategory + PROCESS_RULE_HEURISTIC_TERMS excludes process/docs sources before clause extraction (commit 63da2f78293ad61492ac058511665bd55ec3ac4d); clauses come from extractReferenceClauses (conform-clauses), applicability tagged per (hunk,clause) via applyClauseTags/clauseTagFromChoice with reasons recorded (selection.droppedClauses). Pure/unit-tested in src/review/jev-rules.test.ts (70 pass at head 8f60bf3). PR #722 / b73ef7fd16e4f0a9740972df9040f94c0f0de8fb.

AC3.note: buildReviewScope supplies hunks; for every applicable (hunk,clause) pair one Jev noul asks whether the hunk violates the clause with redacted hunk text + clause text + deterministic facts; --max-calls bounds pairs (round-2 fix 7ca33bb4730beed60ccb91dacbf43c4c22eeb617: budget now ranked code/tests/docs and spent round-robin, reported via hunkCoverage/selection, never landing entirely on the first hunk as before). Live: PR #712 29,526 pairs -> 126 calls (PR body #722); post-fix live check on PR #712: 38 of 38 applicable hunks reached, 38 Jev calls, /usr/bin/zsh.0034 (commit message 7ca33bb). PR #722 / b73ef7fd16e4f0a9740972df9040f94c0f0de8fb.

AC4.note: src/review/jev-rules.ts synthesizeFindingsFromViolations: keryx writes problem/impact/suggested_fix/evidence deterministically from the clause+hunk+Jev probability, never from Jev prose; severity from a documented probability->severity mapping capped at minor unless the rule declares higher; one finding per (hunk,clause) above threshold, deduped per clause+file with a hunk list. Unit-tested in src/review/jev-rules.test.ts describe('synthesizeFindingsFromViolations') (70 pass at head 8f60bf3, 229 expect() calls across the file's suite). PR #722 / b73ef7fd16e4f0a9740972df9040f94c0f0de8fb.
